instruction: Change the default paragraph line spacing to 1.5 lines for all new documents in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default paragraph line spacing for LibreOffice Writer to 1.5 (150% represented as '150' in config). The evaluator checks the LibreOffice configuration file to verify the ProportionalValue setting under Paragraph/LineSpacing. Similar difficulty to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) from VM - the correct location for persistent user preferences
Metric correctly parses XML and searches for the exact path: /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/Defaults/Paragraph/LineSpacing/ProportionalValue
Expected value '150' is semantically correct (LibreOffice stores 1.5 line spacing as '150' representing 150%)
Metric function correctly handles the 'rules' parameter (uses rules['line_spacing'] directly, not rules.get('rules', {}))
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (change default line spacing to 1.5) and evaluator verifies this requirement
State accessibility is sound: config file persists changes automatically, no postconfig needed
Appropriate edge case handling: handles missing file, XML parsing errors, and missing XML paths
Comparison logic is correct: exact string match is appropriate for configuration values
